tools.name: seo_check_page
tools.description: Checks a web page against SEO + GEO (generative engines) + AEO (direct answers) + AIO (Google AI Overviews) standards. Returns a 0-100 score, a score per area and a list of issues in order of importance, each with the fix to apply. Reads only the given page, robots.txt, llms.txt and the social image
